voor.Inside Luxor temple, there's a mosque: You'd hear the call to prayer echo among the ancient columns.

slot.Most ancient Egyptians lived: You'd know every neighbour, and every neighbour would know you.
slot.Every loaf of bread: You'd taste a little sand in it too, I'm afraid.
slot.At harvest time, the scribes: You'd hope your harvest was a good one.
slot.Egyptian craftsmen worked: You could stand in a doorway and watch for hours.
slot.The temple of Karnak: You'd tip your head back and still not see the tops of the columns.
slot.Egyptian children played: You might have played with something very similar yourself.
slot.The palaces of Amarna had gardens: You'd hear water trickling into the pools.
slot.Six chariots were found: You can still see them today, put back together.
slot.In ancient Egypt, taxes were paid: You'd keep a little back for yourself, of course.
